text:
Maya: Sneaker roulette at 12? Bring any spare pair (mismatched, vintage, whatever). 10-minute warmup + 3x stair sprints. Loser buys smoothies? :sweat_smile:
Jordan: Ooh. Do we have to swap shoes? I have runway heels in my desk :grimacing:
Priya: Count me in. Will bring my ancient trail shoes (size 9).
Sam: If anyone brings climbing shoes I'm signing up for routes after :boulder:
Leo: Rules? 🤔 Can we veto obviously unsafe shoes (no flip-flops pls).
Kelsey: Please no Crocs on the stairs. Meeting: front steps by 12:05. I'll bring a small first-aid kit.
Maya: Yes veto flip-flops. Safety is key. Also bring socks. We'll do 3 rounds: 800m jog, 3 stair sprints, then a max pull-up rep.
Priya: I nominate Jordan for judge, since they'll probably be distracted by their heels 😂 @Jordan
Jordan: Deal, I'll do neutral judge face. Also anyone up for a quick afterwave to the climbing wall at 1pm? New topout problem just dropped.
Sam: I'm in for the wall. If my swapped shoes fit, I might flash a v0.5 :muscle:
Leo: Parking note: visitor parking is limited. If you bike, rack is behind the loading dock.
Kelsey: Also FYI the smoothie place next door has a discount for groups if we buy 6. Winner choice of flavors.
FitBot: Reminder: company wellness reimbursement covers up to $10 for post-workout snacks. Upload receipt to expenses.
Maya: Perfect. See y'all out front. Shoes may be judged on 'style', 'noise', and 'terrifying tread'.
